summary: RE-VERIFY of iteration_11 CRITICAL fixes: BOTH FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING. Backend regression 8/8 pass. UI upload flow now sends multipart/form-data (with boundary) and returns 200; new post appears in feed with rendered image. Bad-file 422/400 path no longer crashes React (no 'Objects are not valid as a React child' overlay). Profile photo upload also works via same axios interceptor path.
passed_tests: Backend pytest 8/8 (test_feed_seed.py): explore returns 15 seed storytellers with real Unsplash images, upload post appears in feed, admin seed idempotent, non-admin 403, cleanup_broken 200, public-teaser (no auth) 3+ posts, ghost seed users hidden from /discover and /users/search

FIX #1 VERIFIED: UI /feed → create-post-btn → file-input (JPG) → submit-post-btn — Network request went out with Content-Type='multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary...' and got HTTP 200. New post with caption 'TEST_iter12_upload_verification_xyz' and TestCity location visible in feed; 37/84 loaded with naturalWidth>100.

FIX #2 VERIFIED: Uploading a .txt (non-image) triggered backend 400 (not 422 — content-type gate rejects earlier), and importantly the Feed page did NOT crash. No 'Objects are not valid as a React child' overlay. Page remained interactive.
Profile photo upload from /profile: POST /api/profile/photo with multipart/form-data → 200 OK (confirms axios interceptor fix applies to all FormData callers).
Login and cookie-based auth still work; /feed loads all seed images.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js still keeps the instance-level `Content-Type: application/json` and relies on the request interceptor to strip it for FormData. This works, but a cleaner design would be to drop the instance default entirely so axios per-request negotiation applies naturally (already noted in iteration_11).

Feed.js error handler now safely coerces detail (string/array/object) — good. Consider extracting this into a reusable helper (`formatApiError(error)`) and applying to profile photo/gallery upload handlers to prevent regressions of the React child crash on future 422 sites.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (upload + error render + profile photo all pass)

seed_data_creation: One new post 'TEST_iter12_upload_verification_xyz' with green JPG created by admin during UI test; visible in explore feed. Also one profile photo update on admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_11 critical bugs (Content-Type override for FormData and Pydantic array-detail React crash) are fully fixed and verified end-to-end via browser + backend. If any FormData upload starts failing again in future, first grep for the axios request interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (~line 76) that deletes Content-Type for FormData — it must stay. Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_feed_seed.py is stable and reusable.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification pass, no new issues found.
